sources.entry: Mainsail - Modern and responsive user interface for the Klipper 3D printer firmware. Control and monitor your printer from everywhere, from any device. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Mainsail is a responsive, lightweight web user interface for controlling and monitoring Klipper-based 3D printers from any device.
summary.what_it_does: Mainsail provides a browser-based interface for Klipper 3D printer firmware, designed to work on desktops, tablets and phones. It supports managing multiple printers (a printer farm), uploading, renaming, deleting and editing G-Code and config files in the browser with syntax highlighting, and queuing jobs including adding them from a slicer. It shows print history, usage statistics and job success/failure counts, plus a 3D bed mesh visualisation and a G-Code viewer that follows print progress. Other listed features include multi-webcam views, timelapse recording via moonraker-timelapse, power device control (relays, TP-Link, Tasmota), macro management, temperature presets, extra sensors on the temperature graph, a configurable dashboard, theming, and localization in 12 languages.
use_cases: monitor a 3D printer from a phone or tablet
control multiple Klipper printers from one interface
upload and edit G-Code and config files in a browser
queue print jobs and track print history
view bed mesh and G-Code previews
notable: Built as a front end for Moonraker, the Klipper API
Supports printer farms with multiple printers
Remote mode is mentioned as an additional availability option
Part of the Voron Design community ecosystem
caveats: Requires a working Klipper and Moonraker setup; the README points to external docs for installation
Exclude Objects feature is not officially supported by Klipper yet, per the README
Some features such as timelapse depend on separate components like moonraker-timelapse
